About us

Callaghan Innovation is Aotearoa New Zealand’s innovation agency. We activate innovation and help businesses grow faster for a better New Zealand. We partner with ambitious businesses of all sizes, delivering a range of innovation and research and development (R&D) services to suit each stage of their growth. Our staff – including more than 200 of New Zealand’s leading scientists and engineers – empower innovators by connecting people, opportunities and networks, and by providing tailored technical solutions, skills and capability development programmes, and grants co-funding. As a government agency, we also enhance the operation of New Zealand’s innovation ecosystem, working closely with MBIE, NZTE, NZGCP, Crown Research Institutes, and other organisations that help increase business investment in R&D and innovation. Please contact us for more information about how you can grow faster through technology and innovation. To see our terms of use for online engagement, you can head here: https://www.callaghaninnovation.govt.nz/our-social-media-channels

    This is a great example of the work our Biotechnologies Group is doing, turning science and scale-up expertise into real commercial outcomes.

    Biotechnologies Group

    1,000 followers

    4mo Edited

    Scaling fermentation: what does it take to turn six months of production into less than three weeks? For Shuguang Zhang, it meant leading the technical work to pioneer submerged fermentation of Ganoderma with Alpha Group Holdings Ltd, scaling from lab to pilot and developing a new PC2-compliant process in New Zealand. "Fermentation scale-up is challenging and often underestimated" says Shuguang Zhang. "Seeing Alpha Group commercialise the technology and build a world-first fermentation facility shows how our science created real capability for New Zealand". Today, Alpha Group operates a new facility and commercial product built on that work. If you're thinking about scaling up, talk to our team. Story in the comments below

    From bioprospecting native yeasts for craft brewing to scaling probiotics and supporting vaccine development, the Fermentation and Bioprocessing team turns concepts into scalable solutions. Learn more in the Biotechnologies Group's latest post showcasing the talented people behind their biotechnology solutions.

    Biotechnologies Group

    1,000 followers

    9mo

    Fermentation and bioprocessing are transforming how New Zealand companies develop sustainable and novel food, health and biotechnology products. For innovators developing alternative proteins, biocontrol's or health products, our fermentation facility gives you access to New Zealand’s only pilot-scale fermentation suite (1 L to 1,000 L), approved for GMO work, along with the experts to turn concepts into scalable solutions. We spoke with Fermentation and Bioprocessing Acting Team Lead, Dr Stephanie Harvey, about her work and how the field is evolving: “We’ve bioprospected native yeast strains for New Zealand’s craft brewing industry, scaled probiotics and traditional medicinal fungi for global health and nutraceuticals, and supported vaccine and diagnostic development. Looking ahead, precision fermentation and microbial biomanufacturing will underpin the next generation of sustainable products - and our purpose-built facilities and expert staff accelerate the R&D pathway.” Discover how our Fermentation and Bioprocessing team is helping shape the sector: https://lnkd.in/gChZafjg Follow us for the next in our series showcasing the talented people behind our biotechnology solutions.
